summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat carried a sporting note advertising Tom Allen, "retired champion pugilist of the world," at 619 Market Street, with free concerts every evening and the best singers in the country engaged.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, May 31, 1890, page 7.

facts.fact: Allen's saloon at 619 Market Street, St. Louis, advertised free concerts every evening
